title: Expose common report configuration API and authorized preview engine
description: Add one ReportConfigurationsController for catalog, private definition CRUD/copy/version/publish/restore and preview; authenticated claim ID only. Common ReportConfigurationExecutionService loads selected draft or pinned published revision, validates definition against fresh authorized catalog, and dispatches through reusable registered IReportConfigurationDatasetProvider instead of creating per-business endpoints. Extend initial two fixture adapters to translate finite configuration into existing DynamicSalesOrderReportRequest/PreviewAsync or DynamicReceivableReportRequest/PreviewAsync; map only supported fields/filters/grouping, preserve inherited status/currency/customer/date scope and provider correctness. Return common typed columns/rows/pagination/grouped subtotal/evidence context with separate currency/unit partitions and unknown states; no aggregation over current page represented as all-match totals. Current preview parameters validated, field revocation or deleted/private foreign-owner definition blocks output even if previously published. Query engine async cancellation, finite page limits and precise unsupported-group/formula/relationship errors. Keep adapter query/permission behavior inherited; no custom SQL or extra unbounded dataset reads. Existing OperationLogMiddleware records configuration mutations and POST preview. DI exact registration and API response/error patterns; test generic controller/execution/provider dispatch without real network/DB. Stage 1 of user-directed sequence: finish reusable report configuration platform before any existing-report migration, cross-business flow development or embedded Agent task. No new dedicated business report controller/DTO/designer/exporter. Existing sales-order and receivable datasets are two adapter fixtures proving one shared contract, not report-by-report migration; keep existing endpoints/pages unchanged. Reuse server-authenticated user ID, dataset-specific existing menu authorization and fresh customer data scope; permissions are rechecked on catalog/save/load/preview, saved configurations never grant permission. Finite metadata fields/filters/grouping/operators only, no arbitrary SQL, C# scripts, user-selected tables or joins, client identity/scope/data as authority, mixed currencies/units or duplicate order-header totals from one-to-many joins. Fail unsupported capabilities explicitly rather than pretending they run. Preserve unrelated and current executor work. Code, EF mapping and in-memory/offline relational model tests allowed, but no migration, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modification, production SQL/DB execution, schema/view/stored-procedure mutation, secrets/.env/config changes, production deployment, irreversible operations or real browser-only acceptance. Run meaningful unit/service/API and relevant offline integration tests and configured safe build/test. New metadata tables require later approved database provisioning: absence is an explicit environment blocker for real persistence acceptance, never silently use an in-memory runtime fallback or claim phase complete from build alone. Existing HTTP audit and BaseEntity audit conventions; no ERP business records altered.
acceptance_criteria: One authenticated API exposes owner-only CRUD/version operations and catalog with validated payloads, proper response errors and existing HTTP audit conventions.
Common execution service dispatches validated draft/published definitions through registered dataset providers with fresh permission/scope, preserved currency/unit and truthful page/group coverage.
API/engine tests reject foreign ownership, revoked fields/menu, stale definitions and unsupported capabilities; fixture providers preserve grouping/date/page validation and safe build/test passes.
